class.name: variable_stiffness_controllers/ADLSController
class.description: Anisotropic Damped Least Squares (A-DLS) controller. Implements direction-selective compliance based on GMO collision detection for 7-DOF redundant manipulators (Franka Emika Panda). Supports 4 comparison methods: M1 (Moore-Penrose), M2 (Scalar DLS), M3 (Null-space only), M4 (A-DLS proposed). Paper: "各向异性自适应任务分级与柔顺控制" v5.10.
